attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moves and renames the output paths of several shipped JS assets (setup.js, theme-manager.js, TheAdmin.js, workflow-*.js) referenced via hardcoded script tags/resource manifests, so any downstream themes/modules that reference these old wwwroot script paths directly (bypassing the resource manifest) or override these Assets.json-generated files will break after this change, plus the parcel.mjs change now force-deletes the entire dest folder before each build which could silently wipe co-located non-generated files if a dest folder is shared."}
